title: IQAC | Internal Quality Assurance Cell | KPGU
content: NAAC Revised Accreditation Framework introduced a more structured AQAR process and strengthened the role of ICT in institutional assessment and accreditation. AQAR submission is part of the post-accreditation process, with annual timelines tied to the date of accreditation and supported through the NAAC portal.
